keys.statement: A recycle tolerance set on total flow only can hide errors in individual components; check closure per component where the simulator allows. The paper accepts recycle balance errors below 1 kg/h.

plain.title: Recycle loop converged on total flow: check each component as well
plain.when: A recycle loop reports convergence, but compositions still drift or the plant balance does not close for one component.
plain.do: Check the closure of each tear stream (the recycle stream that is guessed and recomputed) component by component, not only its total flow. Andreasen 2022 accepted recycle balance errors below 1 kg/h.
plain.why: A tolerance on total flow can be met while one component is too high and another too low.
plain.check: In CHEPTA, compare each tear's component flows between two tolerances, and check the plant's component balance (fresh feed plus production equals products) for every component.

decisions.obstacle: A loop that closes on total flow while compositions drift.
decisions.mechanism: Total-flow tolerances do not bound component errors.
decisions.operation: Check component-level closure of each tear.

keys.statement: When some cases of a flowsheet fail but all converge after swapping in another flash routine, the fault is likely an unstable phase-split calculation rather than the recycle solver.

plain.title: Some flowsheet cases fail but all converge with another flash routine: suspect the flash, not the recycle solver
plain.when: In a parametric study some cases of a flowsheet fail, and swapping in another flash routine makes them all converge.
plain.do: Test the flash on the failing streams alone before changing the recycle solver.
plain.why: A phase-split calculation that jumps between iterations breaks the outer recycle loop.
plain.check: In CHEPTA, rerun each failing unit on its captured inlet with the same phases setting; if it fails alone, report it as a flash case. Andreasen 2022 says this indicates, not proves, the cause.

decisions.mechanism: Flash results that jump between iterations break the outer loop.
decisions.operation: Test the flash on the failing streams alone.
limits: The author says this indicates, not proves, the cause.
